typography: horizontal plaque cartouches in heavy ink, kai-weight body, vermilion brush underlines, square cinnabar seal stamps, thin gold double borders, external negation placed beside the phrase
composition: statute cartouches and method bays sit on measured timber grids; priority becomes a descending step-rank; authority tiers nest like a caisson ceiling contracting ring by ring
surface: flat mineral-pigment fields, 退晕 colour-graded bands, double gold frame lines, square seal stamps, bracket-set corner marks; no paper, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: each bay inks in with a horizontal brush sweep and its judgment plaque locks; the interpretation cycle traces its arcs before the centre medallion seals; the rank ladder advances step by step and an override bracket sweeps back to the top
transition: a gold double-line wipe travels along the outer frame border while the previous grid recedes on axis
